identification: Lalique France frosted crystal single dove, open (raised) wings, on a clear ring dish, about 10 cm high. This is the open-wing dove ring dish eBay sellers call 'Thalie' (also 'Charis'/'Pax'-type naming varies). Single bird, not the two-bird 'Colombes' kissing doves dish the Armitage database hints were about. Photo 3 shows an etched script signature inside the base of the column, only partly legible; Armitage tag 555/5 on the dish.
